label: 烘焙骨骼动画 clip
description: 角色路动画烘焙：校验骨骼旋转 q(t)，并可用 root_motion=[{"t":秒,"x":米,"y":米,"z":米},...] 添加模型根帧（Z 向上、X 向前）中相对根骨 bind position 的位移。旋转与根位移共用 fps、duration、linear/step 采样规则；支持仅根运动或与骨骼旋转组合。输出自包含 q_json，根位移逐帧存为 rootTranslation。
description-en: Character animation bake: validate bone rotation q(t) and optionally sample root_motion=[{"t":sec,"x":m,"y":m,"z":m},...] as bind-relative displacement in the model root frame (Z up, X forward). Rotation and root motion share fps, duration and linear/step sampling. Root-only and combined clips are supported; self-contained q_json stores rootTranslation per frame.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.label: 几何
inputs.description: 上游 Geometry（提供 bone 以校验通道键）
inputs.description-en: Upstream Geometry (supplies bones to validate channel keys against).

inputs.name: motion
inputs.label: 运动 q(t)
inputs.description: q(t) 端口：clip 对象或 JSON 字符串（优先级最高）
inputs.description-en: q(t) port: a clip object or JSON string (highest priority).

inputs.name: q_json
inputs.label: q(t) 完整 JSON
inputs.description: 完整逐帧 q(t) JSON：{ "channels": { 骨骼名: number[] }, "rootTranslation"?: [[x,y,z],...], "fps"?, "frameCount"?, "loop"? }。逐帧数组长度须等于 frameCount
inputs.description-en: Full per-frame q(t) JSON: { "channels": { boneName: number[] }, "rootTranslation"?: [[x,y,z],...], "fps"?, "frameCount"?, "loop"? }. Per-frame arrays must match frameCount.

inputs.name: keyframes
inputs.label: 稀疏关键帧
inputs.description: 稀疏关键帧 JSON：{ 骨骼名: [{"t":秒,"q":弯曲弧度}, ...], ... }。按 fps/duration 均匀采样、关键帧间按 interpolation 插值；每骨的点自动按 t 排序。仅当 motion 与 q_json 都为空时使用——agent 对话描述动作首选。
inputs.description-en: Sparse keyframes JSON: { boneName: [{"t":sec,"q":bendRadians}, ...], ... }. Sampled uniformly by fps/duration, interpolated between keyframes per `interpolation`; each bone's points are sorted by t. Used only when both `motion` and `q_json` are empty — the preferred input when authoring from a chat.

inputs.name: root_motion
inputs.label: 根位移关键帧
inputs.description: 稀疏根位移 JSON：[{"t":秒,"x":米,"y":米,"z":米}, ...]。模型根帧 Z 向上、X 向前，值相对 skeleton root 的 bind position；与骨骼关键帧共用采样设置。
inputs.description-en: Sparse root translation JSON: [{"t":sec,"x":m,"y":m,"z":m}, ...]. Model-root frame is Z-up/X-forward and values are relative to the skeleton root bind position; sampling settings are shared with bone keyframes.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.label: 时长（秒）
inputs.description: 仅 keyframes 生效：clip 总时长（秒）；0 或省略 = 自动取所有关键帧里最大的 t
inputs.description-en: Only applies to `keyframes`: total clip duration in seconds; 0 or omitted = auto (max `t`).

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.label: 插值方式
inputs.description: 仅 keyframes 生效："linear"（默认）或 "step"（阶梯保持）
inputs.description-en: Only applies to `keyframes`: "linear" (default) or "step" (hold previous keyframe).

inputs.name: q_path
inputs.label: q(t) 文件路径
inputs.description: 项目相对（或绝对）路径的 q(t) JSON 文件；仅当 motion、q_json、keyframes 都为空时读取
inputs.description-en: Project-relative (or absolute) path to a q(t) JSON file; read only when the others are empty.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: clip 名
inputs.description: 覆盖 clip 名；空 = 用 q(t) 里的 name
inputs.description-en: Override the clip name; empty = keep the q(t)'s name.

inputs.name: loop
inputs.label: 循环
inputs.description: 是否循环播放（写入 clip.loop）
inputs.description-en: Whether the clip loops (written to clip.loop).

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加 animation 语句后的 Geometry（校验失败时原样透传）
outputs.description-en: Geometry after appending the animation statement (passthrough on failure).

outputs.name: animation
outputs.label: 动画 clip
outputs.description: 已解析 clip（{ name, fps, frameCount, loop?, channels, rootTranslation? }）
outputs.description-en: Parsed clip ({ name, fps, frameCount, loop?, channels, rootTranslation? }).

outputs.name: report
outputs.label: 报告
outputs.description: fps / frameCount / durationSec / channelCount / boneChannels / skeletonRoot / rootMotion
outputs.description-en: fps / frameCount / durationSec / channelCount / boneChannels / skeletonRoot / rootMotion.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: 错误
outputs.description: 非致命错误信息（校验失败时返回，几何原样透传）
outputs.description-en: Non-fatal error string (returned on failure; geometry passes through).
